cases.case_label: ~3 kb retrotransposal insertion in FKTN 3'UTR (FCMD founder)
cases.mechanism_detail: A ~3 kb retrotransposal insertion of tandemly repeated sequence (element class not named in the abstract) in the 3' UTR of fukutin is on all founder-haplotype FCMD chromosomes; the gene is expressed in controls but not in patients carrying the insertion.
cases.quote: This gene is expressed in various tissues in normal individuals, but not in FCMD patients who carry the insertion.
